question: After a discount of 54% on the marked price of an item, it is sold for ₹ 29,946. Find its marked price (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 54% discount ⇒ Selling Price = 46% of Marked Price

So, MP = SP ÷ 0.46

MP = 29946 ÷ 0.46

MP = 29946 × (100 ÷ 46)

**∴ Answer = 65100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount = 54%

Selling Price (SP) = 29946

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × 46 ÷ 100

⇒ 29946 = MP × 46 ÷ 100

⇒ MP = (29946 × 100) ÷ 46

⇒ MP = 2994600 ÷ 46

⇒ MP = 65100

**∴ The correct answer is 65100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP)

The listed price of an item before any discount is applied.

Discount Formula

Discount = MP − SP

Selling Price Relation

SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Quick Percentage Trick

If x% discount is given, remaining value = (100 − x)% of MP
